question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is "primarily."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The reason to use **"primarily"** in the blank is to convey that the practice of the service or technology being discussed is mainly or chiefly concentrated in North America. (रिक्त स्थान में **"primarily"** का उपयोग करने का कारण यह बताना है कि जिस सेवा या प्रौद्योगिकी पर चर्चा की जा रही है उसका अभ्यास मुख्य रूप से उत्तरी अमेरिका में केंद्रित है।)
 
• **"Primarily"** indicates that while it may be practiced elsewhere to some extent, North America is the primary region where this practice occurs.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

Correct paragraph:

Alkaline hydrolysis is rare today as a funeral practice__ for humans. Offered to the public for the first time just over a __decade__ ago, it is now permitted and regulated in 26 U.S. states, and practiced __**primarily**__ in North America, where it remains unfamiliar to most people who ______ (4) ______ a loved one or who are thinking about what could ______ (5) ______ to their own bodies when they die.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Lastly: **in the last place (used to introduce the last of a series of points or actions). (अंत में)
 
• **Approximately: **about; roughly. (लगभग; क़रीब-क़रीब)
 
• **Manly: **typical of or suitable for a man. (पुरुष का प्रतिनिधिक या उसके उपयुक्त; पुरुषोचित, मर्दाना)
